newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat drifts lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat drifts lower in quiet trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat drifted lower in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with export sales slowing down and robbing buyers of enthusiasm in Argentina, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for wheat in Bahia Blanca lost $4 to $130. April maize firmed $2 to $102 in moderate volume trade, with some buyers speculating that prices might rebound. May soybeans rose $1 to $253 in middling volume. March sunflower seed was unchanged in slow trade at $206.
